title: File:Amy Roselle, circa 1875-1885 (PORTRAITS 967).jpg
description:
English:

Inscribed below: Yours very truly. PH Coll 98.38

Amy Roselle was an actress known for her Shakespearian roles. She married Arthur Dacre and the two traveled together around Britain, Australia and the United States performing together in productions.
